preamble: Lowering of the nasalized close vowel /ĩ/ to close-mid /ẽ/. In French it is the first step of the Modern French lowering of nasal vowels, /ĩ/ > /ẽ/ > /ɛ̃/ > [æ̃] (Quebec [ẽɪ̯̃]), which produced the open nasal vowel of vin, fin and juin; the later step /ẽ/ > /ɛ̃/ is a separate change. It reflects the cross-linguistic tendency of nasalized high vowels to lower, since nasal coupling raises the perceived first formant.

examples.note: Nasal /ĩ/ lowered to /ẽ/ in the Modern French period; it later opened further to /ɛ̃/.
The same lowering applied to the /ĩ/ of the sequence /ɥĩ/; it is listed with /ĩ/ > /ẽ/ > /ɛ̃/ in the source.

sources: Wikipedia contributors (2026). Phonological history of French: Modern French period (/ĩ/ > /ẽ/ > /ɛ̃/). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phonological_history_of_French
